name: MarkText
description: MarkText's reviewed desktop code uses electron-updater: it disables automatic download, asks the UI about an available update, downloads after the IPC decision, and calls quitAndInstall after the download event. Artifact hash and OS code-signing enforcement are delegated to updater and platform components not established by this source file.
limitations: The checkout is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout.
electron-updater internals, generated release metadata, installer behavior, and OS code-signing policy were not independently established here.
